title: Burst Balloons
summary: Burst all balloons in some order.
statement: Burst all balloons in some order. A burst earns the product of its value and the current adjacent values. An absent neighbor contributes 1. Return the highest possible total.

examples.explanation: Burst 2 first to earn 8, then burst 4 for 4.

hints: Conceptual: Bursting a balloon changes both neighbors.
Directional: Choose the last balloon in an interval so the boundaries are known.
Implementation: For each open interval and possible last burst, combine the two solved subintervals and that final reward.
